message.reasoning_content:
Analyze the kernel: tile_min computed via min where above_mask else sentinel(inf). If no values above pivot, tile_min = inf, tile_eq: above_mask false everywhere → count 0. OK.

Issue: tile_eq uses |data - tile_min| < EPS with absolute tolerance 1e-3 — values within EPS of the min count. Subtle bug: counting logic with single tile is fine. Potential bug: is_new/is_same accumulate logic in the helper — but only called once, so fine.

Another subtlety: values strictly above pivot but within EPS of pivot... the smallest above pivot: a value 0.0005 above pivot counts. Correct per spec.

Risk: min via tl.where(above_mask, data, inf) — if all data inf? Edge. Also data could contain inf? Also if scores dtype is not float32, pivot compare fine.

A subtle issue: if two distinct clusters within EPS? Not applicable single tile.

Edge: values above pivot but tile_min where EPS band overlaps pivot — value strictly above pivot counted correctly.
